guidance.bestFor: An order summary that keeps its status row in view and opens the shipping address and items from an icon button

whenNotToUse.when: A titled status panel that starts open and toggles from its whole header row

guidance.bestFor: A full-width outline button that opens a card of 3 notification channel checkboxes, starting open
agentNotes: Replace `settings` with your channels; each `Checkbox` takes only `defaultChecked`, so no choice is read or saved yet

guidance.bestFor: A single help question in a small card, where the whole question line opens its answer below

whenNotToUse.when: Several help questions listed together that each open their own answer

guidance.bestFor: A billing usage card with a progress bar whose round chevron button, centered on the bottom edge, opens a cost breakdown
agentNotes: The Billing `Button` has no handler and `Progress` is fixed at a `value` of 90; wire both to your billing data
The round trigger is `absolute` and hangs past the card's bottom edge, so leave space below or it overlaps the next element

guidance.bestFor: A price input with a sliders icon button beside it that reveals tax rate and discount fields, its open state held in React state
agentNotes: The 3 `InputGroupInput` fields use `defaultValue` with no form or handler, so nothing reads the price, tax or discount yet

whenNotToUse.when: On or off options picked with checkboxes rather than typed numbers

guidance.bestFor: A deployment status note in a stacked Frame, open on load, its whole header row toggling the release summary

whenNotToUse.when: A summary whose key status stays visible while only the extra details hide

guidance.bestFor: A list of 3 API keys under a toggling Frame header, each row's menu copying its key or deleting the row
agentNotes: Replace `initialKeys` with your keys; Delete only filters the local `keys` state, so call your API from `onDelete`
The plus `Button` sits inside `CollapsibleTrigger` with no handler, so a click on it toggles the list; move it out before wiring an add action

guidance.bestFor: A user handle with avatar that opens to last activity, an online since time and a country flag for location
agentNotes: `AvatarImage` loads from github.com and the flag `img` from flagcdn.com; serve your own images or allow both hosts in your CSP

guidance.bestFor: A 3 level navigation menu of icon rows where folders open in place and the chosen leaf row stays highlighted
agentNotes: Replace `navItems` with your routes; a leaf row only sets `selectedId`, so add the link or router call in `onSelect`
Leaf rows render `Item` as a div with only `onClick`, so the keyboard opens folders but never picks a leaf; render leaves as buttons or links

whenNotToUse.when: A full app navigation column that collapses to icons and turns into a sheet on phones

guidance.bestFor: A code file explorer under Explorer and Outline tabs, file rows showing download and delete buttons on hover or selection
agentNotes: Replace `fileTree` with your files; selection keys on `name`, so give rows a unique id before 2 folders hold the same file name
The download and delete `Button` icons have no handlers, and `TabsList` switches no content, so Outline shows the same files
File rows render `Item` as a div with only `onClick`, so the keyboard opens folders but never selects a file; give file rows a button

whenNotToUse.when: A file explorer people move through with arrow keys rather than row by row clicks
